title: Variant–Trait Claim Atlas: a web tool checking published variant–trait claims against genome-wide evidence
description: Web tool and atlas of 201,720 disease or trait claims read from 71,577 PubMed abstracts, each set against genome-wide significant associations in the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog with a frequency-matched null. The tool looks up variants, genes and traits, checks single claims, screens papers or texts, batch-checks lists and lists the ClinVar risk variants with their genome-wide support. Includes the atlas data, Python and R clients, and the analysis code with the dated analysis plan.
